description: TIE-GCM solves coupled thermospheric and ionospheric dynamics, including neutral and ion species and electrodynamics. Its global pressure-coordinate formulation supports simulations of the upper atmosphere under specified forcing. The resource is documented by UCAR. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere, Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Grid and vertical-coordinate choices constrain resolution; no event-independent forecast accuracy is inferred. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
